source_name: PPRO / NORBr local payment-method country profiles for the Czech Republic
why_relevant: Cross-border PSP enablers publish standardised country payment-method profiles (method shares, COD prevalence, wallet and BNPL penetration) for CZ. Useful for quick English-language benchmarking and for cross-checking local claims, though the underlying data are vendor estimates.

source_name: Deloitte Czech Republic – Press Room (tiskové zprávy, bankovnictví)
source_subtype: consultancy press room / analyst press releases
why_relevant: Deloitte CZ issues Czech-language press releases carrying re-derived banking sector aggregates (sector profit growth, digitalisation ranking, CEE positioning) that summarise otherwise proprietary studies. Examples found include 'Digitalizace českého bankovního sektoru prudce zrychlila' and 'Český bankovní trh zakončil loňský rok rekordně, zisk tuzemských bank vzrostl o 15 %'.

source_name: Deloitte Digital Banking Maturity (DBM) – study landing page CZ
why_relevant: Recurring multi-country benchmark of retail digital banking channels (349 banks / 44 countries in the 2024 edition, ~1,005 functionalities per bank) with an explicit Czech ranking and CE comparison. Free abstract + downloadable report surface functionality-level and consumer-preference data not published elsewhere.

source_name: Deloitte CEE Banking M&A Study
source_subtype: annual regional sector study with CZ chapter
why_relevant: Annual study covering 16 CEE countries with a Czech chapter; supplies market-structure data (sector size ranking, concentration, profitability, capital adequacy, deal flow) used to size and segment the CZ banking market. Referenced in Deloitte CZ press releases as the 8th edition tracking CZ as second-largest CEE market.

source_name: Deloitte Czech Republic – Banking & Capital Markets industry hub
why_relevant: Index page linking Deloitte CZ's banking research outputs (DBM, CEE M&A, payments insights). Useful as a snowball hub to discover new study titles and Czech terminology for them.

source_name: KPMG Česká republika – Bankovnictví (sector hub)
why_relevant: KPMG CZ's Czech-language banking sector page is the entry point to its CZ banking publications and commentary; the legacy home.kpmg/cz path also resolves to banking content. Primary route to KPMG CZ market views on payments and sector economics.

source_name: KPMG Frontiers in Finance (CZ edition page)
why_relevant: KPMG's recurring finance/banking/insurance publication series presented on the Czech site — a free, regularly-issued analyst synthesis that can carry payments and digital-banking themes with CZ framing.

source_name: PwC Czech Republic (pwc.com/cz) – financial services insights
source_subtype: Big Four country site (unconfirmed relevant output)
why_relevant: PwC CZ is one of the four expected analyst voices on the Czech banking/payments market, but no CZ payments report surfaced in cs-language search — the country site must be crawled directly to establish whether such output exists and under what Czech titles.

source_name: EY Czech Republic (ey.com/cs_cz) – financial services
source_subtype: Big Four country site (unconfirmed relevant output)
why_relevant: Fourth Big Four voice; seed query for EY CZ banking analysis returned only academic theses and Deloitte material, so EY CZ output on banking/payments is unconfirmed and needs direct site reconnaissance.

source_name: Raiffeisen Research / RBI – CEE Banking Sector Report
source_subtype: bank research house, annual regional sector report
why_relevant: Flagship annual regional bank-research report with recurring Czech content: CZ share of the CE/SEE revenue pool (~25% in the 2023 edition), sector RoE, and bank-levy/extra-taxation coverage naming Czechia. Free press releases carry the headline numbers even when the full report is restricted.

source_name: Raiffeisenbank ČR – investice.rb.cz news and analyses
why_relevant: Czech arm of the Raiffeisen research chain: local analyst commentary and redistributed RBI research with CZ focus, published in Czech — a local-language route to the same regional analysis.

source_name: Erste Group Research – Czechia country page
why_relevant: Erste's CEE research desk maintains dedicated Czech coverage (named analysts covering the Czech economy and banking sector) with regular macro and banking-sector notes — an analyst re-derivation layer over ČNB data with forecasts not available from official sources.

source_name: Erste Group Research – CEE Banking Sector / Financials equity coverage
why_relevant: Flash comments and in-depth reports on CEE banking stocks, including Czech-listed/Czech-exposed banks — a route to bank-level volume, fee-income and card/payments commentary that equity analysts publish ahead of official statistics.

source_name: Ipsos ČR – Finanční gramotnost topic hub
source_subtype: market-research agency topic hub / survey releases
why_relevant: Ipsos runs the recurring Czech financial-literacy index in partnership with the Czech Banking Association (index at 58 points in the latest wave), plus related consumer-finance waves covering payment fraud awareness, crypto familiarity and household budgets. Free Czech-language press summaries with topline percentages.

source_name: STEM/MARK – Czech survey agency (payment acceptance research)
why_relevant: STEM/MARK is cited in Czech coverage as the fieldwork agency behind payment-acceptance findings (e.g. a quarter of respondents encountering merchants that stopped accepting cashless payment; two-thirds discouraged by non-accepting merchants) — i.e. merchant-side acceptance data relevant to POS coverage.

source_name: Index prosperity Česka – Platební chování chapter
why_relevant: Analyst-style aggregator (Česká spořitelna / Europe in Data ecosystem, with the Institute of Sociology CAS involved in the survey) publishing a dedicated Czech payment-behaviour chapter: card vs cash preference, cash carried, mobile/wearable payment shares, and the share of shoppers abandoning purchases where cards are not accepted. Representative sample of 1,521 respondents, fieldwork August 2024.

source_name: NIQ Retail Spend Barometer – Czech Republic
why_relevant: Combines NIQ and GfK real sales data into quarterly Czech retail turnover indicators across FMCG and technical consumer goods. Not payments data as such, but the denominator for card-spend penetration and a cross-check on POS transaction value trends.

source_name: GfK (NIQ) – syndicated Shopper & Retail studies catalogue (CZ)
why_relevant: Czech-language catalogue of GfK's off-the-shelf syndicated studies (e.g. 'GfK Supermarket, Diskont & Hypermarket', run annually since 1998). The catalogue pages expose methodology, sample and topic coverage for free — enough to know which paid study would carry payment-method-at-checkout data.

source_name: NIQ Shopper Trends (CZ coverage)
why_relevant: Annual syndicated shopper study whose country coverage includes the Czech Republic, tracking channel shift and checkout behaviour; free abstract pages state scope and can reveal payment-method modules.

source_name: GlobalData / Research and Markets – Czech Republic Cards and Payments (Opportunities and Risks to 2028)
source_subtype: commercial market-research report + free distributor abstract
why_relevant: The classic paid CZ cards-and-payments report: card volumes and values, split by instrument (cards, cash, direct debit, credit transfer, cheques), historic and forecast. Its distributor press release on GlobeNewswire is a free abstract carrying the scope and often a few headline figures — exactly the 'paid abstract' pathway this cell targets.

source_name: Mordor Intelligence – Czech Republic POS Terminals Market
why_relevant: Directly on-topic for the ATM/POS dimension of this run: CZ POS terminal market sizing and growth (stated CAGR 13.76% over the forecast period) with a free, unusually detailed abstract and a separate market-trends subpage. Useful as a triangulation point against ČNB/CBA terminal counts.

source_name: Mordor Intelligence – Czech Republic E-commerce Market (payment-method split)
why_relevant: Free abstract carries a CZ e-commerce payment-method breakdown (cards ~38.6% share; BNPL growing at ~8.1% CAGR to 2031) and cites ČNB card-usage penetration — a rare free source of online payment-mix estimates for CZ.

source_name: MarketDataForecast – Czech Republic Cards and Payments Market to 2033
why_relevant: Second-tier vendor forecast covering CZ cards and payments to 2033; low intrinsic credibility but useful as a divergence check across vendor estimates and for spotting which segments vendors bother to size.

source_name: Statista – Digital Payments in Czechia (study) and Digital Payments Market Outlook
why_relevant: Statista maintains a Czechia-specific digital payments dossier plus the Digital Payments Market Outlook model, giving transaction-value and user-penetration estimates for CZ segments. Free preview pages give definitions, segment structure and some headline values; the full dossier is subscription-gated.

source_name: McKinsey & Company – Czech Republic office insights + Global Payments Report
why_relevant: McKinsey's Global Payments Report is built on a Global Payments Map spanning 25+ payment products across 47 countries; the CZ country insights page is the route to any Czech-specific cut. Free full-report PDFs are published, making it one of the few strategy-consultancy payment datasets available at no cost.

source_name: BCG – Payments and Transaction Banking practice publications
why_relevant: BCG's annual Global Payments Report and transaction-banking publications provide European/CEE revenue-pool framing that CZ figures are usually benchmarked against. No CZ-specific output confirmed, so value is contextual rather than country-level.

source_name: CMS – Emerging Europe M&A Report, banking & finance chapter
why_relevant: Annual professional-services (law firm + EMIS data) analysis of CEE banking/finance deal flow with country breakouts; a free analyst synthesis of CZ banking-sector consolidation that complements the paid Deloitte M&A study.

source_name: Czech business media as analyst-report amplifiers (Forbes.cz, Euro.cz, E15, Seznam Zprávy, Kurzy.cz)
source_subtype: media amplification layer / pointer to primary studies
why_relevant: Czech-language business media reliably republish the topline numbers of analyst and agency studies that are otherwise gated — card counts, cash-carrying shares, mobile payment adoption, survey sample sizes. Often the only free route to figures from STEM/MARK, Ipsos, Mastercard and Deloitte studies, and a discovery channel for studies whose own pages never surface in search.
